channel.title: NPR Topics: Education
channel.description: We've been to school. We know how education works. Right? In fact, many aspects of learning — in homes, at schools, at work and elsewhere — are evolving rapidly, along with our understanding of learning. Join us as we explore how learning happens.

item.title: Amid Trump's assaults on DEI, how one university is elevating Black students
item.description: As many colleges roll back or eliminate such programs, Sacramento State has expanded its offerings for students of color.

item.title: Can the new federal voucher program help public schools? Democrats are torn
item.description: The new scholarship tax credit program could help public school families pay for some educational services, but advocates worry it could do more harm than good.

item.title: Schools struggle to measure how much AI experiments are helping
item.description: Schools are experimenting with AI, and a lot of them are encountering the same problem: It's hard to measure whether the technology is good or bad for students.

item.title: The University of Nevada now offers students the opportunity to minor in mariachi
item.description: The University of Nevada, Las Vegas, now offers a minor in teaching mariachi. The music remains popular among young people and someone's got to teach them how to play it.

item.title: Cornell's Faculty Senate considers no-confidence vote for school's president
item.description: Cornell says it's making big changes on campus following the allegations of a gang rape, but it remains under fire. The Faculty Senate is now discussing a no-confidence vote of the president.

item.title: Cornell University bans frat parties, vows to address 'disturbing' campus culture

item.title: After his university cutbacks, Trump announces $100 million for STEM researchers
item.description: The Trump administration is funneling $100 million into educating STEM researchers who are U.S. citizens. The move comes after other changes under Trump have forced cutbacks in university research.
